description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Unstructured to Actionable: Extracting Wind Event Impact Data for Enhanced Infrastructure Resilience is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Huy Pham, Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (vt.edu). This project employs zero-shot text classification with pre-trained BART-large models to efficiently extract and analyze critical data on infrastructure and community impacts from wind disaster reconnaissance reports. While primarily focused on wind, the methodology can be applied to various hazards, including earthquakes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-r46y-g112. Keywords: Wind disaster and resilience, Structural damage, Community damage, Text mining, Zero shot classification, Impact based forecasting. Published 2024-06-12. Facility named: StEER - Structural Engineering Extreme Event Reconnaissance. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
